# Vnyan script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## vnyan.send

Starts every "API Message" node in VNyan with this action name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `action` | The name typed into the API Message node. Capital letters matter. |
| `payload` | `payload` | Optional. An object of values for the node; numbers stay numbers and text stays text. name=value lines also work. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vnyan.send", new { action = "Cheer", payload = new { user = "Ann", bits = 100 } });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vnyan_send(action="Cheer", payload={"user": "Ann", "bits": 100})
    ```

## vnyan.sendWebSocket

Runs VNyan's "WebSocket" nodes with this command (Start Receiver must be on in VNyan).

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `command` | The node's Command Text. |
| `value` | `value` | Optional. A number sent after the command; the node gives it on as Value. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vnyan.sendWebSocket", new { command = "Throw", value = 5 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vnyan_send_web_socket(command="Throw", value=5)
    ```

## vnyan.setParameter

Sets a VNyan parameter over OSC (VNyan's OSC port must be set on the VNyan card).

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `name` | The parameter's name without brackets. |
| `value` | `value` | A number sets [name]; text sets <name>. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vnyan.setParameter", new { name = "donor", value = "Ann" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vnyan_set_parameter(name="donor", value="Ann")
    ```
